title: P6 Korupcja
description: This mod adds P6. P6's tools and P6's fat. There is also a biome where he naturally spawns, which is in the forest.
body: This mod introduces a brand-new character called P6, along with a full set of unique P6-themed tools and a special material known as P6’s fat. In addition to that, a new biome has been added — a mysterious forest area where P6 naturally spawns. Players can explore this forest to find P6 wandering among the trees, gather his resources, and craft powerful tools inspired by him. The mod brings humor, adventure, and creativity together, making it a fun addition for anyone who enjoys exploring new creatures and collecting rare items in their Minecraft world.
